note: Trainable 2-layer GCNConv / GATConv on Queen contiguity (and county clique sensitivity). SGC L2 Raw∥diffuse + Ridge/RF kept as baseline. NonSpatial MLP matches hidden size. Fit on all years < test_year; early-stop monitors last pre-test year MAE in z-space (that year stays in train). Features and targets StandardScaler-fit on train; predictions inverse-transformed before MAE. Hyperparams: hidden=32, layers=2, dropout=0.15, lr=5e-3, wd=1e-4, max_epochs=250, patience=35, gat_heads=2, seed=42, CPU.
